name: This Fruit Could Bite Back

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you know sustainable food sources like hearty desert fruits can help feed Orgrimmar and the Horde's growing population.
As a cook, you can prepare prickly pears into dishes, and the fruit can also supply city residents.
As a herbalist, you know how hardy desert plants can be and how much effort it takes to gather spiny wild fruits for cultivation.

aliases: what is this fruit could bite back
this fruit could bite back quest
faq.answer: You gather wild prickly pears in Durotar for cooking and save their seeds to plant across the dry land around Orgrimmar.
faq.q: What is This Fruit Could Bite Back?

faq.answer: Prickly pears provide food for local meals, and their seeds are saved for planting. The aim is to grow them across the arid land around Orgrimmar.
faq.q: Why are prickly pears being gathered?

faq.answer: The seeds are meant to be planted throughout the outskirts and lands around Orgrimmar, where they can help establish a resilient food supply in the harsh desert soil.
faq.q: Where will the seeds be planted?

faq.answer: A local resident wants the harvest to improve local food stores, feed travelers, and grow crops suited to Durotar's harsh desert climate.
Prickly pears have sharp spines and needles like other hardy desert cacti, so gatherers must take care.
Durotar is mostly arid and rocky, making conventional farming difficult. Drought-tolerant prickly pears could help provide a lasting food supply for Orgrimmar.
faq.q: Why is planting fruit around Orgrimmar important?

sections.body: Durotar is rugged and sun-baked, where traditional farming is nearly impossible. Its hardy prickly pears thrive in the arid soil, so inhabitants gather them to help feed Orgrimmar. Their protective spines call for care, and their fruit brings needed nourishment.
sections.title: Harvesting the Arid Wastes

sections.body: Prickly pears feed people now and can help supply food in the years ahead. Their flesh is prepared for dishes, while their seeds are carefully preserved for planting. The aim is to grow this resilient crop around Orgrimmar, creating a lasting food source close outside the fortress walls.
sections.title: Cultivation and Sustenance

summary: In Durotar, prickly pears feed Orgrimmar and promise more food ahead. Gathered with care, these hardy fruits can nourish the Horde capital and provide seeds for future crops.
